settings.heading: TheSkinBay
settings.subheading: A curated membership for those who take their skincare seriously. Earn recognition, access and rewards with every order.

settings.question: How do I start earning points?
settings.answer: Simply create a free account and place your first order. Points are credited automatically once your order is confirmed.

settings.question: When do my points expire?
settings.answer: Points are valid for 12 months from the date they were earned. We recommend redeeming regularly to make the most of your balance.

settings.question: How do I redeem my points?
settings.answer: Log in to your account, visit the rewards section and select your voucher. The discount code is generated instantly and applied at checkout.

settings.question: Can I earn points on sale items?
settings.answer: Yes. Points are earned on the total amount paid across all orders, including sale and bundle purchases.

settings.question: Can I refer friends?
settings.answer: Yes. Each successful referral earns you 100 points, credited once your friend completes their first order. There is no limit on referrals.

settings.heading: Become a Member
settings.body: Membership is complimentary and instant. Start earning on your very next order.
settings.note: Free to join. No minimum spend required.

settings.image_alt: A hand holding a phone showing The Skin Bay BayPoints rewards balance of 1,250 points
settings.caption: Check your balance, unlock member perks and redeem points straight from your account.
